description: Remaining 2 routing cases for game-quality-and-release-gates (GQRG-01 already executed separately, per execution-ledger.json), converted from evals/skill-routing-cases.csv for real execution against cloudbox-skills task #7 (statistical-rigor gap). Both rows test that game-quality-and-release-gates is correctly NOT selected (expected_routing=false in the CSV's column for this skill); per the CSV's own note column each prompt has a genuine alternative owner rather than no skill at all, matching the established convention in evals/runtime/cases/touched-skills-negative-routing.json (CAG-NEG-01/REF-NEG-01/ENG-NEG-01: expected.primary_skill set to the real alternative owner, forbidden_selected_skills carries the skill under test): GQRG-NEG-01 is generic ISO 25010 server-application quality with no game/device lifecycle (owned by software-quality-iso25010), GQRG-NEG-02 is legacy game asset pixel/density/upscale audit (owned by game-asset-resolution-audit).
